label: PF Backlog 286
title: Versioned per-model eligibility policy schema (Doc2 s14): allowed/restricted tasks, quality floor, max_task_cost, fallback, independent_review
body: Doc2 s14/s13. Model eligibility is ad-hoc (agent-capability-vector + model_gate needs) with no per-model policy: allowed_tasks, restricted_tasks, quality_threshold, max_task_cost, fallback, independent_review. Need a versioned policy schema + validator; consumed by the model-strategy gate/router. Owns config/model-policy.json + core/model_policy.py.
